# Seats loyal to the president. Not running (non-democratic US) = no check.
wif_ue_congress_majority = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = wif_ue_congress_majority_tt
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ue_on }
			AND = {
				check_variable = { wif_ue_house_pct > 50 }
				check_variable = { wif_ue_sen_pct > 50 }
			}
		}
	}
}

		OR = {

			AND = {
				check_variable = { wif_ue_house_pct > 59.99 }

			}
		}
	}
}
